title: Atlas and Ledger
author: Jude Dunmore
blurb: Juniper Thornbury, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ice breaks on the river.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
